name: @ziweijs/core-wasm
description: Browser WebAssembly binding for the Ziwei chart engine

scripts.build: pnpm run build:types && wasm-pack build ../../crates/ziwei_binding --target web --dev --out-dir ../../packages/core-wasm/generated --out-name native
scripts.build:release: pnpm run build:types && wasm-pack build ../../crates/ziwei_binding --target web --release --out-dir ../../packages/core-wasm/generated --out-name native
